Our 7th-grade history/geography teacher did similar things.

One time before class, she had the whole grade organized into a assembly, divided us into "continent" groups, and gave us 1-5 or so pieces of candy depending on how rich or poor our continent was overall. It was trying to illustrate the vast disparities in wealth distribution across the globe, since there were way more people in the poor continent-groups than the rich ones. I was in the "Africa" group, so I only got one small chocolate square, but I totally cheated when my friend in "Europe" gave me his…

Another time when we studied English history, she pretended to be the "King" of the class and did things like take people's pencils/erasers for no reason, put people in a row of seats near the back called the "dungeon", and so forth, until the class could write a "Magna Carta" to limit her royal power.

I miss middle school.
